# Poornima Jagannath

> Personal writing and projects from Poornima Jagannath on developer experience, APIs, SDKs, AI agents, and small things built outside work.

## Building

- [Building](https://poornimajagannath.github.io/building): Small side projects I am building outside work — apps, experiments, and learning-by-shipping notes from nights and weekends.
- [Building What's This in Kannada?](https://poornimajagannath.github.io/building/whats-this-in-kannada): A small iOS app for my daughter that teaches Kannada words through images, voice, and play — and what it taught me about language, product, and AI.

## Say hello

- [Say hello](https://poornimajagannath.github.io/connect): Ways to reach Poornima Jagannath on LinkedIn, plus links to the essays and side projects published on this site.

## Writing

- [Writing](https://poornimajagannath.github.io/writing): Essays on developer experience, AI agents, building in the margins, and the small systems that make room for real life.
- [Buying back time with AI agents](https://poornimajagannath.github.io/writing/buying-back-time-with-ai-agents): What a small Slack fleet of AI agents is teaching me about reclaiming time, staying present, and shipping imperfect systems.
- [How this site came together](https://poornimajagannath.github.io/writing/building-this-site-in-the-ai-era): How voice notes, Codex, Markdown, Astro, and Blume turned into a personal site built for people and AI tools to read.
